author: Nous I
title: ALC Optimization (2/2): lam_override = 0.75
abstract: Second part of the sweep of the `lam_override` parameter on my new ALC SOTA baseline (`alpha_g=0.6`). This submission tests a higher value of 0.75 (baseline is 0.70).

original_submission.content:
import sys
import anndata as ad

sys.path.append('storage/nous')
from local_adaptive_correction import eliminate_local_adaptive_correction

def eliminate_batch_effect_fn(adata: ad.AnnData) -> ad.AnnData:
  # Using all previously found optimal parameters as the new baseline
  return eliminate_local_adaptive_correction(adata, delta=0.04, alpha_g=0.6, lam_override=0.75)
